Oho!

Wiktionary

oho! aha! (surprise or joy)

(vōx cōmica: Plaut.)

Other words

  • Eho! — ho! what? (in an indignant question or a command)

    also used · classical · Ter. And. 5.4.5; Plaut. Bacch. 4.7.5 (Lewis & Short s.v. eho); Traupman 353: oho!, eho! · Wiktionary

    (vōx cōmica: Plaut., Ter.)

    eho is not surprised delight but a challenge: eho tū, look here, you!

See also hey!, well, well!, aha!.
